questions.question: How do I book my free trial lesson?
questions.answer: Head to our [contact page](contact.html) and fill out the short enquiry form. We'll get back to you within 24 hours to find a teacher and time that suits you.

questions.question: What instruments do you teach?
questions.answer: We currently offer private lessons in piano, violin and cello, as well as music theory. Send us a message and we can give you further options! We also offer the ABRSM, Trinity and AMEB examination syllabus. See our [lessons page](lessons.html) for details on each.

questions.question: What age can my child start?
questions.answer: We recommend piano to children 4+, violin and cello to ages 6+. Woodwind instruments 8+ (for breath control!) Definitely send us a message either way because we are very flexible in considering individual circumstances. Adults are always welcome- it's never too late to start.

questions.question: Do I need my own instrument?
questions.answer: For your trial lesson we can usually provide an instrument in the studio. For regular lessons you'll need one at home to practise on- we're happy to advise on buying or renting good-quality instruments.

questions.question: Where are lessons held?
questions.answer: Our studio is in a home in Woden. Once your lesson is confirmed we'll send you the full address and parking details.

questions.question: Do students have to sit exams?
questions.answer: Not at all. Many students enjoy the structure of AMEB or Trinity exams, but they're entirely optional. We mainly aim to set goals that motivate you, whether that's a certificate, a performance or a favourite piece.

questions.question: How much should I practise?
questions.answer: Practice is extremely important to your learning! Each practice schedule depends on the student and the teacher, but as a general guideline I would recommend 4-5 times a week 15-20 minutes each session. Advanced students (Grade 7+) should aim to practice at least an hour.

questions.question: Are there performance opportunities?
questions.answer: Kreutzer is a young studio, and organising our first student recital is one of our goals for 2027. Ask your teacher about performance goals that suit you.

questions.question: Can parents sit in on lessons?
questions.answer: Yes, especially for young beginners, a parent in the room helps practice at home. There's also a comfortable waiting area if you'd prefer to step out.

questions.question: How much do lessons cost?
questions.answer: See the [full fee schedule](terms.html#payment) for longer lessons and advanced rates.

questions.question: What if I need to cancel a lesson?
questions.answer: Please give at least 24 hours' notice to reschedule a lesson. Full details are in our [terms and conditions](terms.html).

questions.question: How do I pay?
questions.answer: Lessons are paid in advance by bank transfer or cash. We'll send an invoice with each package.
